title: Verify the admin Fees & Discounts page needs the Settings → Service permission
custom_preconds: 1. A ZZAUTOTEST role is assigned to Tech (exact-user-match) WITHOUT Settings → Service.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as a role without Settings → Service (for example Tech) and try to reach Administration → Service → Fees & Discounts.
2. Restore the role afterward.
custom_expected: Without Settings → Service, the 'Fees & Discounts' nav item is not shown under the SERVICE section and navigating directly to the admin Fees & Discounts page is blocked (it bounces to the Work Orders page); templates cannot be created/edited/deleted. Settings → Finance alone does not grant access.
